high_level_description: stc brand style, a nighttime industrial facility with glowing beacon connectivity icons and a satellite formation in the sky above.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A desert facility at night with warehouse buildings lit by warm floodlights, a starry sky, and a crescent moon.

elements.desc: A row of satellites with solar panels flying in formation across the night sky.
A glowing white and red vertical light beam rising from the facility roof, flanked by a globe/no-signal icon and a WiFi signal icon connected by dashed lines.
